The show features prominent leaders spanning the worlds of business, finance, politics and culture. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Japanese Stocks Fall as Topix Weighting Announcement Sours Mood
top_signals.summary: Japanese equities were down for a second day as an announcement about changes to Topix Index weightings prompted selling in stocks set to see their index presence reduced.
